examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The library at rest: type in the search field or pick a facet to narrow the grid; when nothing matches, the empty state clears every filter.

examples.name: NoResults
examples.summary: No story to list yet: the grid gives way to the empty state. A search or a filter that matches nothing shows the same state with its clear-filters action (see the site example).

examples.name: Paged
examples.summary: A `page-size` of two: the grid shows the first two stories and the load-more button reveals the next page; changing the search or a facet returns to the first page. Below the large breakpoint the toolbar folds to a filter button, the shorter search placeholder and a chip per applied facet.
